(A while ago i joined a kickstarter for some 3d files for a d&d game.  The idea that a mountain was carved away into a dwarven fortress city is still pretty dang cool and i would love to make a dungeon delve quest game on the theme of exploring a lost civilization like that. I would like an artist to create an overworld tile and possibly some outside tileset or paralax image.I have printed and painted this IRL but this is the art from the source. I dont need it to be exact something inspired by this would work.
